class.name: InterDVDDisc
class.brief_description: Scene-tree root for an Interactive DVD. Compiles to [InterDVDProject] at export.
class.description: Author titles, menus, and encode settings on this node instead of ProjectSettings. Child [InterDVDTitle] and [InterDVDTitleSet] nodes become VTS titles. Child [InterDVDMenuPage] nodes become VMGM/VTSM menus. [method build_project] is the export IR. Project → Tools → Create Interactive DVD Scene inserts a VLC-safe skeleton (title menu, main title, menu title).

method.name: add_chapter_to_last
method.description: Appends a chapter to the last title, creating a title if needed.

method.name: add_menu_title
method.description: Appends a VLC-safe menu title PGC ([member InterDVDTitle.menu_title], still 255).

method.name: add_title
method.description: Appends a title child and returns it.

method.name: add_title_menu
method.description: Appends a VMGM title menu with still time 0.

method.name: add_root_menu
method.description: Appends a VTSM root menu on the last title set, or as a disc child.

method.name: apply_settings_to
method.description: Copies disc identity, encode, extras, and languages onto [param project]. Used by [method build_project].

method.name: apply_scene_owner
method.description: Sets [param owner] on this node (if it is not the owner) and every descendant so the scene tree saves children.

method.name: build_project
method.description: Walks children and returns the authored disc graph. Resolves hotspot [member InterDVDHotspot.destination] paths to title numbers. [constant FIRST_PLAY_TITLE_MENU] leaves First Play empty when a title menu has buttons (export JumpSS). [constant FIRST_PLAY_MAIN_TITLE] writes JumpTT to the first non-menu title.

method.name: create_starter
method.description: Builds Disc / TitleMenu+Play / Main+Chapter1 / Menu+Play with Play jumping to Main.

method.name: find_in_tree
method.description: Returns [param root] if it is an [InterDVDDisc], otherwise the first descendant disc, or [code]null[/code].
